news.title: Arsenal beat Everton to go level on points with leaders Man City
news.summary: Goals from Ezri Konsa, his first for the club, and Gabriel Magalhaes helped Arsenal beat Everton 2-0 at the Emirates to move level on points with league leaders Manchester City.
